Prepared the issue #216 baseline design; no pilot or paired comparison ran and no readiness is claimed.
Added the [manifest template](../benchmark/baseline/run-manifest.template.json): 62 null-valued run fields, each with an unresolved reason.
Added the [development-only precision/cost method](../benchmark/baseline/README.md), without numeric repetitions, thresholds or spending allocation.
Added the [stdlib structural checker](../benchmark/scripts/baseline.py) with a frozen required-field list and no environment-dependent inputs.
`python3 -I benchmark/scripts/baseline.py --check` exited 0, validating all 62 undecided fields.
In-memory mutation checks rejected missing/extra fields, non-null values, blank reasons and extra entry properties.
`python3 policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check` exited 0; baseline evidence remains missing and benchmark_executed/benchmark_ready remain false.
Preparation indexes remain unchanged; pinning follows review. No commit was run.
Unresolved fields cover provider/model/modalities, generation settings/seeds, prompts/input hashes, arm instructions and reader/tool/runner/scorer versions.
Also unresolved: split/keys/native evidence, isolation, matched budgets, repetitions/order/stopping/ceiling, inventories/probes, uncertainty and cost accounting; each reason is in the template.

## What next
Saved work is in the three linked files. Arrange separate review of protocol coverage and the pilot method, then Policymaker-directed pinning.
Before dependent pilots, resolve accepted cases/keys/split, tested isolation, model quota and an independently reviewed scorer.
The next cold session should reuse the recorded checks, avoid repeating startup reads, and keep undecided fields null until supported by evidence; structural validation does not establish readiness.

Waiting for the owner: request #217.
